title: Conditional R-078: give spin feedback direct stroke authority
hypothesis: Applying spin-error feedback directly to the periodic stroke raises slow-spin success without restoring the harmful capture compression.

prediction.against: R-078 constant-stroke-gain control on the qualified exact zero-curl parent
prediction.rationale: Beating an equally evaluated constant-gain control distinguishes useful feedback from merely strengthening the open-loop stroke. This conditionally re-triages R-078 because the first proposal supplies a prospective qualification path; its earlier deferral measured no repair outcome.

protocol.command: gpu run bash -lc 'source ~/IsaacLab/source_env.sh && python scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py --study r081_conditional_raw_stroke_feedback'
code_changes: config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml: add r081_conditional_raw_stroke_feedback with a hard preflight requiring r080 qualification and its no-more-drops condition; otherwise consume no episodes or seeds.

scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py: reuse the frozen stroke decomposition; compare qualified clamp, direct stroke feedback, and constant stroke gain while leaving compression zero and every other term unchanged.

config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml: predeclare feedback gain clip(4/max(abs(spin_rate),1),0.5,2); freeze the constant control to this gain's arithmetic mean over the archived D-052 clamp observations before any new rollout.

scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py: require gain=1 to reproduce frozen clamp actions bit-for-bit; score all three arms on promotion cases 10-39 and fresh cases 40-119 of one frozen 120-case manifest.

scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py: report paired sustained success, drops, gain activity and saturation; retain the standard strict 30-case promotion gate and prohibit retries or retrospective panel enlargement.

falsified_by: The fresh paired interval's upper bound against the constant-gain control is below +0.05. An interval including zero does not establish feedback benefit; failure to beat the qualified parent under strict promotion, or more observed drops, blocks adoption.

advisor.reasoning: The constant-gain control distinguishes useful online regulation from simply strengthening the stroke, a mechanism R-078's deferral did not test. Defer its 330 simulator episodes and zero LLM calls until R-080 actually qualifies the exact zero-curl parent; a possible qualification path is not yet qualification. If feedback activates without improving success, prioritize R-043 rather than continuing automatically to another stroke repair.

implementer.reasoning: Agree to defer until R-080 qualifies the exact zero-curl parent; the constant-gain control stays.
